name: Cursed Form
description: Quinary ability: toggle Cursed Form on to gain 20 Curse immediately, 10% lifesteal, movement speed and attack speed. Curse rises by 1% per second until toggled off, then drains by 0.25% per second. Toggling it off starts a 20-second cooldown. Reaching 100 consumes the meter and triggers the 25-second overfill.
